classification: Additional content-quality screen recorded after first-batch results and five extension URL records. It corrects observed title-detector misses; it is not an original prespecified analysis rule.
reason: PyPI yielded HTTP 200 and title Client Challenge, which the collector did not recognize. Raw observations and collector flags must remain unchanged. Ranking eligibility must describe intended content rather than a recognized challenge or error document.
rule: Exclude a run whose case-insensitive title matches client challenge; exact Oh noes!; your access has been blocked; are you a robot; access to this page has been denied; exact Error Page | eBay; or Page Not Found optionally followed by a dash/pipe suffix. Apply identically to both batches. Require at least three remaining valid runs. Preserve all attempts and report the change from collector eligibility.
scope: Title-based screen cannot guarantee detection of all interstitials. No content bypass, extra navigation, URL replacement or outcome-targeted rerun. Recognized routing interstitials are also excluded. No new website request is needed for this title audit.
known_observation: All five recorded PyPI search runs show title Client Challenge.
first_batch_title_audit: Other recognized error/challenge titles were already excluded by raw collection outcomes; pooling preserves their records.

post_collection_checks.rule: Exclude runs with titles starting Hang Tight! Routing to checkout, case-insensitive. Apply identically to both batches.
post_collection_checks.evidence: All five Patagonia runs retain the requested product URL with HTTP 200 and title Hang Tight! Routing to checkout...; this is a routing document rather than the requested product content.
post_collection_checks.timing: Recorded after collection and after an initial pooled calculation. Exclusion is based on document validity, not a score or desired correlation.
